title: AI Models Score Some English Accents Lower, Study Finds
paragraphs: Some computers can score speech. They listen to a person and give points. Researchers at the University of Washington tested four of these AI models.
The AI models gave American and British speakers the highest points. They gave Chinese and Nigerian speakers the lowest points. The words in each speech were the same.
This is not fair. The researchers want AI makers to check their tools. They should test many accents, not only one.

questions.a: Researchers at the University of Washington.

questions.q: Which accents got the highest points?

questions.a: They want AI makers to check their tools for many accents.
